title: VERTEX In-Game HUD Consolidation & 2.5D Level Selector Directions
brief: Definitive HUD (Top Perks + Compact Numeric Chips) and 3 distinct 2.5D Level Selector architectures

artboards.title: 04 — DEFINITIVE IN-GAME HUD: Top Perks + Pure Numeric Chips (No Bars) + Full-Screen Mode Styling
artboards.tradeoff: Eliminates redundant progress bars (Presupuesto & Ruido are crisp numeric chips), places ALL Perks/Tools in the Top Bar, frees the bottom bar completely, and applies Sector 0's rich background & ring styling to all 4 modes.

artboards.title: 05 — Selector Opción A: Rack Isométrico + Sidebar Derecha
artboards.tradeoff: Split screen with right sidebar dossier.

artboards.title: 06 — Selector Opción B: 2.5D Coverflow Card Deck (Full-Screen Audio Wave + Hero Center Card)
artboards.tradeoff: No sidebar cutting the screen: full-width audio wave across the horizon and a huge central Hero Card that holds the live mini-map, lore, and deploy button right in the middle while side missions recede in 2.5D scale.

artboards.title: 07 — Selector Opción C: 3D Depth Spine Tunnel + Bottom Command Strip
artboards.tradeoff: Leaves 80% of the canvas open for a diagonal 3D network spine receding into a vanishing point with the audio wave riding the cable, and puts the mini-map + lore in a sleek horizontal cockpit strip at the bottom.
